haiku.problem: The worm is a minor detail. The more important card, God asking Jonah whether he has any right to be angry (verses 4 and 9), was left out, and it is the passage's central point.

Without the word 'next,' the question 'After Jonah got angry over a withered plant, what did God ask him?' also fits God's question in verse 9, 'Have you any right to be angry about the plant?' The baker could argue for a true answer not listed, so it doesn't point clearly to the verse 11 question about Nineveh.
